node.content-desc: Row 1. signal: El Niño. ocean: Warmer central/eastern Pacific. effect: Below-normal rainfall, more dry spells, higher heat risk. reason: Weakens moisture flow and circulation

node.text: Below-normal rainfall, more dry spells, higher heat risk

node.content-desc: Row 2. signal: La Niña. ocean: Cooler central/eastern Pacific. effect: Above-normal rainfall. reason: Strengthens circulation and moisture transport
Row 3. signal: Positive IOD. ocean: West Indian Ocean warmer than east. effect: Often supports stronger monsoon rain. reason: Adds moisture and can counter El Niño

node.text: West Indian Ocean warmer than east
Adds moisture and can counter El Niño

node.content-desc: Row 4. signal: Negative IOD. ocean: East Indian Ocean warmer than west. effect: Often weakens monsoon rain. reason: Reduces convection and worsens El Niño's impact

node.text: East Indian Ocean warmer than west
Reduces convection and worsens El Niño's impact
